resources.string: Enter the pairing code from your OfflineSMS dashboard.
This relay app is private and works only with an approved OfflineSMS Business account.
Battery optimization is on. Android may stop the relay in the background. Disable it for reliable delivery.
Latest 100 events · newest first · updates automatically
No activity yet. New events will appear here.
No warnings or errors in the latest 100 events.
Could not load activity. Reopen this screen to try again.
The message was handed to the SIM. Waiting for the send result.
Android confirmed sending. This does not yet confirm delivery to the recipient.
A delivery report confirmed arrival at the recipient. It does not confirm that the message was read.
The message may have been sent fully or in part. Sending again is blocked on this device to avoid duplicates.
The allowed sending time expired before the message reached the SIM.
The relay was paused before sending this message.
Could not verify permission to send this message. Check the internet connection and device status.
The sending request had no valid time limit, so it was not sent.
A sending problem was recorded without a detailed cause. Check the SIM, signal and device status.
Android reported an error for all message parts. Check the SIM, signal and SMS balance.
This processing cycle did not complete. Check the internet connection and device status.
This is a processing summary, not a delivery confirmation. See each message result.
Could not send the status update to the server. Check the internet connection. This does not mean an SMS failed.
The device reported its status to the server.
Some status reports remain on this device. Sync will retry automatically; this does not resend the SMS.
Server did not accept a status report
This report will not be retried. Ask the administrator to check the device and message reference. The SMS may already have been sent.
An event was recorded while reporting a message status to the server.
This device was linked to the business account.
Check the pairing code and internet connection, then try linking again.
An additional service event was recorded. Open details for its event code.
